title: Anterior STEMI pattern · ACS 00004
selectionReason: A modest interventricular recovery prior avoids the relaxed model’s extreme RV APD offset at a small training-error cost. This is a prior-informed teaching choice, not a uniquely recovered patient map. Subsequent plateau-shape and phase-focused recovery searches did not improve the training QRS/whole-beat tradeoff sufficiently to replace this default. A separately labeled ST/T-focused regional-prolongation alternative is preserved with its own field, waveform and errors.

atJ.fiducialStatus: Uses the same approximate reviewed J point as the target; not expert-annotated or automatically exact.

terminalTWindow.status: Descriptive minimum in a fixed late-T window, not an expert-annotated T-wave peak or a new fitting target. Existing training selection was complete before this feature was summarized.

numericalVerification.predictionMethod: Direct 1 ms all-source Vm × physical reciprocal lead-field products; no histogram approximation in the selected published trace.

sourceSummary.membraneVoltageScaleStatus: Modeled −85/+25 mV ventricular reference, not measured patient Vm. Optical AP template supplies a normalized recovery shape.
sourceSummary.injuryRestPlateauAttribution: Illustrative fixed 60:40 split of fitted AP excursion loss into resting depolarization and peak/plateau depression; surface ECG after PR subtraction does not identify these separately.
sourceSummary.injuryCoreDefinition: LV native source nodes with modeled smooth lesion weight>0.5; a hypothesis, not a measured infarct border.

uncertainty.interpretation: Candidate/start spread and bounds describe model sensitivity, not statistical confidence or patient-specific identifiable physiology.
uncertainty.selection: bestNumericalApproachId minimizes raw-mV training RMSE across I,II,V1–V6 on analysisWindowMs. selectedApproachId may instead be an explicitly prior-informed teaching default. Held-out beats do not fit or select source parameters.
uncertainty.validationScope: Held-out alternating beats from the same short recording test within-record reproducibility. They are not independent patients, external clinical validation or an invasive-map comparison.
uncertainty.candidateSetRule: Pathology candidates with training whole-window RMSE no more than25% above the selected model; a sensitivity set, not a confidence region.
uncertainty.scope: Spread among a finite set of explored source-model candidates. It omits untested anatomies, noise models and many other physiologies; it understates total inverse uncertainty.
